purpose: Trigger-boundary regression set for ugt-nextjs-database-setup. S* queries must route here; N* queries must NOT (auth tables → auth-setup, CI → cicd-setup, sonar → clean-code, runtime bugs → pitfalls).
method: 3 independent judges, randomized order, full skill listing incl. superpowers distractors

baseline_result.method_note: Judges ran as subagents given the skill listing as TEXT (generated from the repo SKILL.md frontmatter) and instructed to answer only from it — the 2026-08-03 contamination, where judges named their own environment skills, did not recur: every answer came from the supplied listing.
baseline_result.note: S-side 24/24 including the symptom-only queries (reserved-word column, data-preserving rename, `url` in the wrong place). N-side 18/18: auth tables went to auth-setup, the sonar query to clean-code, the date-shift symptom to pitfalls. One secondary variance: the conceptual 'ubiquitous language' query (N6) split between domain-modeling and (no skill) — both acceptable, neither is this skill.

revalidation_2026-09-06.reason: Description gained "a stored-procedure call that times out (mssql 15-second default)" (904→~970 chars) after the 2026-09-06 full rerun showed pitfalls N10 ("เรียก stored procedure แล้ว timeout ตลอดเลย") routing to debugging skills 3/3 — references/raw-sql-and-sp.md §4 already documents the requestTimeout fix, the description just never claimed the symptom. New S9 added for the same intent. Re-ran this skill's full set + pitfalls N10.
revalidation_2026-09-06.method_note: Same text-isolated listing as the 2026-09-06 revalidations (17 ugt skills at this commit + superpowers 6.3.0 / mattpocock-skills 1.2.3 / frontend-design distractors, 47 entries); 3 judge subagents, each with its own shuffle of the 16 queries.
revalidation_2026-09-06.note: S-side 27/27 incl. new S9 (SP timeout in app but fine in SSMS) 3/3. N-side 18/18 primary and secondary (auth tables, CI migrate, sonar violation, date shift, vitest, domain-modeling all routed away correctly). pitfalls N10 now → ugt-nextjs-database-setup 3/3 (was debugging skills 3/3 before the description change). No regression on the eight original S queries.
